This is the license for the Silk Remington Typewriter ATR font, which covers both the compiled fonts (TTF, OTF, and webfont files) and the source code used to generate those fonts, specifically the UFO files. This font is available to download from the official GitHub repo. This repository is the only official source for the Font. If there's any confusion about what font this license applies to, having the download link in the Definitions section should make it pretty clear.
PREAMBLE / SUMMARY OF THE LICENSE
I am not proud of this font, and consequently I don't want it to be used in public. I designed it to be used on the American Type Revival website because I needed a monospaced typeface that felt period appropriate, but in general I dislike attempts to literally capture letters designed for typewriters (which is what this font is) because I feel that what looks good on a typewriter tends to translate pretty poorly to other mediums. I am releasing both this font and its source code publicly (perhaps against my better judgment) because I think there is a certain utility or public interest in being able to pick apart and understand how fonts are made. Therefore, you are permitted to download and tinker with or use this font as much as you like privately, but you are very much forbidden from using or distributing the font in any public capacity (outside of a couple of exceptions which I spell out below).

When I say "the Font," I am referring to everything that I designed that is unique to this font project. These are the upright and italic files for both the finished exported font files, like the TTFs, the OTFs, and WOFF2 files, and the source files used to generate those, like the UFOs. If the license only protected the finished fonts and not the source code, then it would be trivial to use the source code to generate new font files and circumvent the license. Therefore, I want to be clear about "the Font" meaning both the source code and the finished font files.
When I say "the official GitHub repo," I am referring to the repository hosted at the link: https://github.com/American-Type-Revival/Silk-Remington-Typewriter

You must make it clear that you are hosting a clone and that you do not represent American Type Revival and are not affiliated with American Type Revival.
Any modification you make to the repository clone must be exclusively in service of making the disclaimer that it is not the official GitHub repo. It must be possible for people to easily remove any and all modifications to the repository you make, which means changes should be clearly delineated.
Once you start hosting a clone under these terms, you do not need to continue checking that the official repo is unavailable. If the official repo goes back online and you were already hosting a clone, you may continue hosting that clone.

If you write to me and ask for permission to use the Font for a specific project, and I grant that permission in writing BEFORE you use it in that project publicly, you are permitted to use the Font. This permission only extends to what was outlined clearly in writing.
